titles.en: Do not act against the articles of Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 that the regulation lists

summaries.en: Acting against Articles 2(1) and (2), 3(1) and 4(1) of Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001, the EU regulation on specific restrictive measures against certain persons and entities to combat terrorism, is prohibited under this Dutch regulation, which is made under the Sanctions Act 1977.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Depart from the prohibition only where an authorisation under the EU regulation's derogations applies
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling terrorisme 2002, BWBR0013736, art. 1 lid 2 en 3, text in force from 2026-04-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0013736&artikel=1

titles.en: Depart from the prohibition only where an authorisation under the EU regulation's derogations applies

summaries.en: The prohibition does not apply where Article 2a(1), 2b(1), 2c(1), 5(1) or (2) or 6(1) or (2) of Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 has been applied. The competent authority under Articles 2a(1), 2b(1), 2c(1) and 6(2) and (3) of that regulation is the Minister of Finance or the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, each within their own competence.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the information Article 4(1) of Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 asks for to De Nederlandsche Bank
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling terrorisme 2002, BWBR0013736, art. 1 lid 4, text in force from 2026-04-08; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0013736&artikel=1

titles.en: Give the information Article 4(1) of Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 asks for to De Nederlandsche Bank

summaries.en: A bank, an e-money institution, a payment service provider, an insurer and the other institutions under Article 10(2)(a), (c) and (e) to (j) of the Sanctions Act 1977 give the information Article 4(1) of Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 asks for to De Nederlandsche Bank. Investment firms, fund managers and the other institutions under points (b), (d) and (k) give it to the Authority for the Financial Markets, and the Minister of Finance is the competent authority under Articles 4 and 5 of that regulation.

summaries.en: Article 3(2) of Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 applies equally to the starred persons, groups and entities, with this difference: the information that article refers to is brought only to the attention of the Ministry of Finance.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act outside the starred-persons prohibitions only under an exemption the minister grants on request

titles.en: Freeze all assets belonging to the persons named in the annex

summaries.en: All assets belonging to the persons named in the annex are frozen. Assets are property of any kind and the documents showing ownership of or an interest in it, such as bank credits, cheques, shares and bonds; freezing means preventing any change, transfer or use that would alter their amount, location, ownership or destination or allow their use, the management of an investment portfolio included.

titles.en: Provide no financial services to the persons named in the annex and make no assets available to them

summaries.en: It is prohibited to provide financial services, which cover services of a financial nature such as banking services, for or for the benefit of the persons named in the annex. It is also prohibited to make assets available to them, whether directly or indirectly.

titles.en: Freeze all assets of the persons and organisations designated by ministerial decision

summaries.en: The Minister of Foreign Affairs, in agreement with the Ministers of Justice and of Finance, can adopt a designation decision for persons or organisations found to belong to the circle that Security Council Resolution 1373 describes, and announces each designation in the Staatscourant. All assets belonging to a designated person or organisation are frozen.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide no financial services to designated persons or organisations and make no assets available to them

titles.en: Provide no financial services to designated persons or organisations and make no assets available to them

summaries.en: It is prohibited to provide financial services for or for the benefit of a designated person or organisation and to make assets available to them, directly or indirectly. The freeze and these bans do not apply to persons and organisations on the list of Article 2(3) of Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 or in Annex I to Regulation (EC) No 881/2002, or covered by the Sanctieregeling terrorisme 2002-II.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Depart from the national freeze only under an exemption granted on request

obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Markttoegang financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020413, art. 2 en art. 3, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020413&artikel=2

titles.en: File a licence application on the supervisor's form, in a single copy and in assessable form

summaries.en: An application under the Wft provisions the article lists, among them Articles 2:3b(1), 2:10b(1) and 2:12(1), is made on the form the supervisor sets and provides on request, and the form and the data go in as a single copy. The data are given in a form that lets the supervisor assess them properly, and the authors of statements and reports sign or certify them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the data the decree lists in an application for a bank licence
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Markttoegang financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020413, art. 8 lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020413&artikel=8

titles.en: Give the data the decree lists in an application for a bank licence

summaries.en: A bank licence application contains the bank's identity, legal form, registration and certified articles, its intended activities, data on the suitability and reliability of its policymakers and supervisory board members, descriptions of its integrity policy, control structure and business organisation, any consolidated supervision, and documents showing its own funds, expected solvency and liquidity. Where relevant it adds the qualifying holders or twenty largest shareholders with data on their reliability, financial position and group structure, and, for a subsidiary of a foreign bank, its home supervisor's or the ECB's approval; personal data come with a CV, diplomas, identity document, antecedents and referees, and reliability data are not needed for persons whose reliability a supervisor has already established.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the data the decree lists when applying under Article 2:17 of the Wft to operate from a branch in the Netherlands
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Markttoegang financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020413, art. 10 lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020413&artikel=10

titles.en: Give the data the decree lists when applying under Article 2:17 of the Wft to operate from a branch in the Netherlands

summaries.en: A bank that applies under Article 2:17 of the Wft gives its identity, legal form, registration and articles, the branch address and the activities it intends to carry on from the branch, data on the suitability and reliability of the persons concerned, descriptions of the integrity policy and business organisation of the branch, any consolidated supervision, and data showing the bank's own funds, expected solvency and liquidity.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the data the decree lists in an application for a payment or e-money licence
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Markttoegang financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020413, art. 3a lid 1, 2 en 6, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020413&artikel=3a

titles.en: Give the data the decree lists in an application for a payment or e-money licence

summaries.en: A payment service provider or e-money institution applying for a licence gives, among other data, a business plan with a budget forecast for the first three financial years, its internal controls against money laundering and terrorist financing, its organisational structure, agents, branches and outsourcing, its qualifying holders, its auditor, data on its policymakers, how it safeguards users' funds, and its own funds. It also describes its procedures for security incidents and complaints, for sensitive payment data and for business continuity, its statistics on performance, transactions and fraud, and its security policy with a detailed risk analysis; a provider that offers only account information services leaves out the items the article excludes.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the data the decree lists when notifying the use of a passport or a branch abroad
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Markttoegang financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020413, art. 44 en art. 45, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020413&artikel=44

titles.en: Give the data the decree lists when notifying the use of a passport or a branch abroad

summaries.en: A bank's notification under Article 2:108 of the Wft contains the data of Article 3 of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 1151/2014 on exercising the right of establishment and the freedom to provide services. A bank that intends to operate from a branch in another state under Article 2:111 gives that state, the branch address and activities, the names and private addresses of the persons who will run the branch, and descriptions of the integrity policy and of the business organisation for sound and ethical operation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the data the decree lists when providing investment services through a branch or tied agent in another member state, and report changes
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Markttoegang financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020413, art. 58 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020413&artikel=58

titles.en: Give the data the decree lists when providing investment services through a branch or tied agent in another member state, and report changes

summaries.en: An investment firm, or a bank under Article 2:128a of the Wft, that notifies a branch or the use of a tied agent in another member state gives its contact details, the member state, a programme of operations, the branch's organisational structure and any tied agent, the address where documents can be obtained, the persons who run the branch, and the information of Article 6 of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/2018. It reports changes to those subjects in line with Article 7 of that regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify De Nederlandsche Bank when relying on the payment exclusions of Article 1:5a, points (k) and (l), of the Wft
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Markttoegang financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020413, art. 1a lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020413&artikel=1a

summaries.en: A service provider that carries on one or both activities under Article 1:5a, point (k)(i) and (ii), of the Wft, where the payment transactions of the previous twelve months exceed EUR 1 million in total, notifies De Nederlandsche Bank with a description of the services and the exclusion relied on. A provider of an activity under point (l) notifies De Nederlandsche Bank with an auditor's statement, given every year, that the activity stays within the maximum amounts of that point.

titles.en: Use the small payment service provider exemption only within its conditions and report changes

summaries.en: A payment service provider is exempt from the licence requirement only for payment services 1 to 5 of the annex to the payment services directive, while its payment transactions over the previous twelve months, agents included, average no more than EUR 3,000,000 a month, none of its policymakers has the antecedents on money laundering, terrorist financing, property crime or financial supervision offences the article names, and it has notified De Nederlandsche Bank. The safeguarding rules of Article 3:29a of the Wft and Articles 26e to 26h of the Bpr apply to it, and it tells De Nederlandsche Bank of every change relevant to these conditions.

titles.en: Use the small e-money institution exemption only within its conditions and report changes without delay

summaries.en: An e-money institution with legal personality is exempt from the licence requirement only while it issues e-money in the Netherlands, its financial liabilities tied to issued e-money average no more than EUR 5,000,000, none of its policymakers has the antecedents the article names, it issues e-money only on instruments or accounts that can hold at most EUR 150 at a time, and it has notified De Nederlandsche Bank. It tells De Nederlandsche Bank without delay of every change relevant to these conditions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold the higher of the fund-manager capital requirement and the IFR capital requirement
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling specifieke bepalingen IFR en IFD, BWBR0045790, art. 2:1, art. 2:2 en art. 1:2 lid 1, text in force from 2026-02-11; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0045790&artikel=2:1

titles.en: Hold the higher of the fund-manager capital requirement and the IFR capital requirement

summaries.en: A manager of an investment fund or UCITS that carries on an activity or provides an investment service under Article 2:67a(2) or 2:69c(2) of the Wft is subject to the higher of the capital requirement of the UCITS or AIFM rules and the capital requirement of the IFR. Under the IFR that requirement is the highest of the fixed overheads requirement, the permanent minimum capital requirement and the K-factor requirement, or of the first two only where the manager meets the small and non-interconnected conditions of Article 12(1) IFR.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate the IFR capital elements over the whole business and the investment services provided
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling specifieke bepalingen IFR en IFD, BWBR0045790, art. 2:3 tot en met 2:6, text in force from 2026-02-11; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0045790&artikel=2:3

titles.en: Calculate the IFR capital elements over the whole business and the investment services provided

summaries.en: The manager calculates the fixed overheads requirement under Article 13 IFR over the total costs of its business, the permanent minimum capital requirement under Article 14 IFR as if it were an investment firm under Article 9 IFD and by the investment services it provides, and the K-factor requirement under Part Three of the IFR on the scale of those services. It applies the Commission's regulatory technical standards for these calculations and the transitional provisions of Article 57 IFR.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out the internal capital and liquidity assessment of the Bpr even as a small and non-interconnected investment firm
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling specifieke bepalingen IFR en IFD, BWBR0045790, art. 3:1, text in force from 2026-02-11; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0045790&artikel=3:1

titles.en: Carry out the internal capital and liquidity assessment of the Bpr even as a small and non-interconnected investment firm

summaries.en: An investment firm that qualifies as small and non-interconnected under Article 12(1) IFR, and a manager that meets those conditions, complies with Article 24a1(1) of the Besluit prudentiële regels Wft. This does not apply where it provides only the investment services of points (a) or (d) of the definition in Article 1:1 of the Wft.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use the CRR delta formulas for options and swaptions only where they give a correct result
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling specifieke bepalingen IFR en IFD, BWBR0045790, art. 3:2, text in force from 2026-02-11; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0045790&artikel=3:2

titles.en: Use the CRR delta formulas for options and swaptions only where they give a correct result

summaries.en: An investment firm may use the delta formulas and parameters of Article 279a CRR to calculate the supervisory delta of options and swaptions under Article 29(6) IFR and the delta of Article 329(1) CRR. When it does, it applies Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/931 where relevant, and it does not use them where they give no result or a delta that does not correctly approximate the change in the option price against the price of the underlying.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Replace missing historical data in the K-factor calculations with the firm's business projections
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling specifieke bepalingen IFR en IFD, BWBR0045790, art. 3:4, text in force from 2026-02-11; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0045790&artikel=3:4

titles.en: Replace missing historical data in the K-factor calculations with the firm's business projections

summaries.en: An investment firm replaces missing historical data under Articles 17(2), 18(2), 19(3), 20(3) and 33(4) IFR with data based on the business projections it submitted under Article 7 of Directive 2014/65/EU.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep capital adequacy procedures, reporting systems and conglomerate-wide risk governance
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentieel toezicht financiële groepen Wft, BWBR0020415, art. 2a lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020415&artikel=2a

titles.en: Keep capital adequacy procedures, reporting systems and conglomerate-wide risk governance

summaries.en: A firm under Article 3:269a(1) of the Wft has adequate capital adequacy procedures to identify and measure all material risks and match its own funds to them, and sound reporting and accounting systems to identify, measure, monitor and control intragroup transactions and risk concentration. For risk management it also has sound governance in which the bodies concerned approve and periodically review strategies and policies at conglomerate level, an adequate capital adequacy policy, and procedures that integrate the risk monitoring systems of the regulated entities so that risks can be measured, monitored and controlled for the conglomerate as a whole.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report significant intragroup transactions with a mixed-activity holding to the supervisor once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentieel toezicht financiële groepen Wft, BWBR0020415, art. 4 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020415&artikel=4

titles.en: Report significant intragroup transactions with a mixed-activity holding to the supervisor once a year

summaries.en: A bank or investment firm whose parent is a mixed-activity holding files the report on significant intragroup transactions and positions with that holding and its subsidiaries with De Nederlandsche Bank or the European Central Bank once a year, or more often if either decides so because its solvency is or could be at risk. Significant means above a threshold, tied to the solvency held, that De Nederlandsche Bank sets after consulting the bank or investment firm.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate the financial conglomerate's supplementary capital adequacy by an Annex B method
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentieel toezicht financiële groepen Wft, BWBR0020415, art. 23 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020415&artikel=23

titles.en: Calculate the financial conglomerate's supplementary capital adequacy by an Annex B method

summaries.en: A firm under Article 3:296(1) of the Wft, which heads a financial conglomerate, calculates the conglomerate's supplementary capital adequacy under the rules of the decree, using one of the methods in Annex B. The supplementary capital adequacy is sufficient when the result of that calculation is not negative.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide the supplementary capital adequacy calculation and the management information on it every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentieel toezicht financiële groepen Wft, BWBR0020415, art. 24 lid 1 en 3, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020415&artikel=24

titles.en: Provide the supplementary capital adequacy calculation and the management information on it every year

summaries.en: The head of the conglomerate provides the calculation of supplementary capital adequacy once a year, or more often if De Nederlandsche Bank decides so because of developments in it. Once a year, at a time it sets after consulting De Nederlandsche Bank, it also provides the information on supplementary capital adequacy given to the conglomerate's group management.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the conglomerate's significant risk concentrations and the management information on them every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentieel toezicht financiële groepen Wft, BWBR0020415, art. 26 lid 1, 2 en 5, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020415&artikel=26

titles.en: Report the conglomerate's significant risk concentrations and the management information on them every year

summaries.en: A firm under Article 3:297(1) of the Wft reports the conglomerate's significant risk concentrations once a year, or more often if De Nederlandsche Bank decides so, where significant means above a threshold De Nederlandsche Bank sets after consulting the other supervisors and the conglomerate. Once a year it also provides the information on risk concentrations given to the conglomerate's group management.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the conglomerate's significant intragroup transactions and the management information on them every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentieel toezicht financiële groepen Wft, BWBR0020415, art. 27 lid 1, 2 en 5, text in force from 2026-09-22; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020415&artikel=27

titles.en: Report the conglomerate's significant intragroup transactions and the management information on them every year

summaries.en: A firm under Article 3:298(1) of the Wft reports the conglomerate's significant intragroup transactions and positions once a year, or more often if De Nederlandsche Bank decides so, where significant means above a threshold De Nederlandsche Bank sets after consulting the other supervisors and the conglomerate. Once a year it also provides the information on intragroup transactions and positions given to the conglomerate's group management.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report intragroup positions above 20 per cent of the capital requirement with a mixed-activity holding within two months after year end
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling prudentieel toezicht financiële groepen Wft, BWBR0020705, art. 2 lid 1 tot en met 3 en art. 3, text in force from 2009-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020705&artikel=2

titles.en: Report intragroup positions above 20 per cent of the capital requirement with a mixed-activity holding within two months after year end

summaries.en: A credit institution whose parent is a mixed-activity holding reports all significant intragroup transactions and positions with the holding and its subsidiaries on sheet 1 of the annex form, at the latest two months after the end of the financial year. A single transaction, and a total position, is significant when it exceeds 20 per cent of the institution's capital adequacy requirement; for each the report gives the amount of the claim, asset items and comparable off-balance sheet instruments only, and the group company concerned, sorted into the categories of the table. A credit institution also under conglomerate supervision may report under paragraph 7 instead.

titles.en: Report risk concentrations above 20 per cent of the conglomerate's own funds within four months, by type of exposure

summaries.en: The firm reports, on sheet 7 and at the latest four months after the end of the financial year, all significant risk concentrations at conglomerate level towards one person or institution or a group of connected ones, leaving out insurance risks and exposures to or guaranteed by the Dutch State or Dutch lower authorities. A concentration is significant above 20 per cent of the conglomerate's own funds, and for each the report gives the name and a split into loans, guarantees given including derivatives, and other exposures, with an explanation of the guarantees and other exposures.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Market, distribute or sell no binary options to retail clients in or from the Netherlands
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit verbod op de markt brengen, verspreiden of verkopen van binaire opties aan niet-professionele cliënten ex Verordening (EU) nr. 600/2014 en Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0042121, art. 1 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2019-04-19; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0042121&artikel=1

titles.en: Market, distribute or sell no binary options to retail clients in or from the Netherlands

summaries.en: Marketing, distributing or selling binary options to retail clients in or from the Netherlands is prohibited. A binary option is a derivative, traded on a venue or not, that is or may be settled in cash other than on default, pays only at early termination or at expiry, and pays a predetermined fixed amount or zero depending on whether the underlying meets predetermined conditions. The ban does not cover an option whose lower fixed amount at least equals everything the retail client pays for it, fees included, or one that runs for at least ninety calendar days, has an approved prospectus available to the public and exposes the firm to no market risk and no profit or loss beyond disclosed fees.

titles.en: Take no part in activities that get round the binary options ban

summaries.en: Knowingly taking part in activities whose object or result is to get round the binary options ban is prohibited, and so is acting as a substitute for the person who markets, distributes or sells binary options for that purpose.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Supply through the portal the identifying data the decree lists on clients held in the bank's records
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit verwijzingsportaal bankgegevens, BWBR0043903, art. 9 lid 1 en art. 2, text in force from 2022-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0043903&artikel=9

titles.en: Supply through the portal the identifying data the decree lists on clients held in the bank's records

summaries.en: A bank or payment service provider connected to the bank data referral portal makes the technical and organisational arrangements to supply client data through the portal, as far as its records hold them. For a natural person these are the name, the name on the product, address and address type, date of birth, role as holder or authorised person, client and product status, product number and type, whether the account is suitable for benefit payments and any issuing contracting party; for a legal person the name, the name on the product, address, Chamber of Commerce or comparable number and client and product data.

obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit verwijzingsportaal bankgegevens, BWBR0043903, art. 3 lid 1, 3 en 4, text in force from 2022-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0043903&artikel=3

titles.en: Secure the portal connection and answer account checks within five seconds and other requests within thirty

summaries.en: Each connected party makes the technical and organisational arrangements its duties under the decree need. The security of its systems and of the connection to the portal guarantees the confidentiality and integrity of the data supplied, and its systems answer requests to verify a bank account number within five seconds of receipt and other demands and requests within 30 seconds.

obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit verwijzingsportaal bankgegevens, BWBR0043903, art. 8 en art. 10 lid 1, text in force from 2022-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0043903&artikel=8

titles.en: Have policymakers, supervisory board members and staff take the oath or affirmation within three months of starting

summaries.en: The persons the Wft requires to take the oath or affirmation, policymakers, supervisory board members and the staff of Articles 3:17b and 4:15a, take it within three months of starting work for the firm, where possible before a person in a higher position as the article defines one. Someone who returns to the firm and can show they took the same oath there before need not take it again, unless more than five years have passed since they left.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use the prescribed oath forms and set a staff form with at least the five required elements
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling eed of belofte financiële sector 2015, BWBR0036152, art. 2 lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2015-04-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0036152&artikel=2

titles.en: Use the prescribed oath forms and set a staff form with at least the five required elements

summaries.en: Policymakers use the form of Annex 1 and supervisory board members the form of Annex 2. For staff the firm sets its own form, which at least covers acting with integrity and care, weighing the interests of all parties carefully with clients and society first, putting the client's interest first, complying with laws, regulations and codes of conduct, and keeping and promoting trust in the financial sector.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Take the oath by reading out the form and the closing words, and have the form signed on the spot
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling eed of belofte financiële sector 2015, BWBR0036152, art. 3 en art. 4, text in force from 2015-04-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0036152&artikel=3

titles.en: Take the oath by reading out the form and the closing words, and have the form signed on the spot

summaries.en: The person before whom the oath or affirmation is taken reads out the text of the form, after which the person taking it speaks the prescribed closing words of the oath or of the affirmation. The person who took it then signs the form in the presence of the person before whom it was taken; a self-employed person without staff may simply sign the form.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the signed oath or affirmation accessible for as long as the person works for the firm
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling eed of belofte financiële sector 2015, BWBR0036152, art. 5, text in force from 2015-04-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0036152&artikel=5

titles.en: Keep the signed oath or affirmation accessible for as long as the person works for the firm

summaries.en: The firm keeps the signed oath or affirmation in an accessible way at least for as long as the person works for it, or ensures that the taking of the oath or affirmation is recorded in another way.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Control conflicts of interest in financial instrument transactions and keep inside information within need-to-know circles
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit marktmisbruik Wft, BWBR0020417, art. 20 en art. 21, text in force from 2024-04-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020417&artikel=21

titles.en: Control conflicts of interest in financial instrument transactions and keep inside information within need-to-know circles

summaries.en: A firm under Article 5:68(1) of the Wft takes adequate measures to control conflicts of interest relating to transactions in financial instruments. It also takes adequate measures to keep inside information from becoming known outside the circle of people who need it for their work, and to make sure that persons connected to it handle information they know or ought to suspect is inside information with the utmost care.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not invest in, lend to or take unlisted stakes in producers of cluster munitions
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit marktmisbruik Wft, BWBR0020417, art. 21a lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2024-04-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020417&artikel=21a

titles.en: Do not invest in, lend to or take unlisted stakes in producers of cluster munitions

summaries.en: A firm under Article 5:68(1) of the Wft, other than a clearing institution, takes adequate measures to avoid trading to acquire or offer financial instruments issued by a firm that produces, sells or distributes cluster munitions or their key components, lending to such a firm, or acquiring non-tradable stakes in it, and the same for a firm holding more than half of its share capital. The ban does not cover index trades and third-party managed funds with less than five per cent in such firms, or finance for well-defined projects that does not serve cluster munitions, and holdings already in place are sold or ended within a reasonable period.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint a person to oversee these rules internally and let staff report market abuse breaches internally
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit marktmisbruik Wft, BWBR0020417, art. 22 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2024-04-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020417&artikel=22

titles.en: Appoint a person to oversee these rules internally and let staff report market abuse breaches internally

summaries.en: A firm under Article 5:68(1) of the Wft appoints a person responsible for internal supervision of compliance with this chapter of the decree and sets rules for that supervision. A firm under Article 5:68(1) or (4) has appropriate procedures that let its employees report possible or actual breaches of the Market Abuse Regulation internally.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record every own-account transaction in financial instruments with its date, time, instrument and price
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit marktmisbruik Wft, BWBR0020417, art. 23, text in force from 2024-04-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020417&artikel=23

titles.en: Record every own-account transaction in financial instruments with its date, time, instrument and price

summaries.en: A firm under Article 5:68(1) of the Wft keeps records of the transactions in financial instruments it carries out for its own account, showing the transactions of each day, the instrument concerned, the date and time each was carried out, the identity of any third party that carried it out, and the price or prices.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a code of conduct for private transactions, designate insiders and keep a list of them
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit marktmisbruik Wft, BWBR0020417, art. 24 lid 1 tot en met 4 en art. 25, text in force from 2024-04-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020417&artikel=24

titles.en: Keep a code of conduct for private transactions, designate insiders and keep a list of them

summaries.en: A clearing institution, and a bank not authorised to provide investment services, a fund manager, an insurer and the other firms the article names that hold a qualifying holding in an issuer or traded EUR 20 million or more in financial instruments in the past calendar year, keep a code of conduct for private transactions by connected persons involved in the firm's transactions or regularly holding inside information, make it known to everyone concerned and monitor compliance, unless the firm decides under article 25(3) to designate no one as an insider. The code has rules for all those persons and extra rules for insiders, whom the firm designates, with procedures for doing so, and it keeps a list of designated insiders.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make the code require avoiding mixed interests and have insiders report their private transactions
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit marktmisbruik Wft, BWBR0020417, art. 26 en art. 27, text in force from 2024-04-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020417&artikel=26

titles.en: Make the code require avoiding mixed interests and have insiders report their private transactions

summaries.en: The code requires the persons it covers to avoid any mixing of business and private interests, or its reasonably foreseeable appearance, connected with transactions in financial instruments. It requires insiders to report their private transactions as the code prescribes and to do their best to have third parties whose investments they influence give the internal supervisor information on their private transactions on request; it may exempt categories of instruments whose reporting serves no purpose.

titles.en: Hold a 4.5 per cent systemic risk buffer on Norwegian exposures once they exceed NOK 5 billion

summaries.en: A bank with its seat in the Netherlands, or an investment firm under the CRR, whose risk-weighted exposures in Norway exceed NOK 5 billion holds a systemic risk buffer of 4.5 per cent for its exposures in Norway, calculated under Article 133(2) CRD, on an individual, sub-consolidated and consolidated basis as Part One, Title II, of the CRR applies.

titles.en: Hold a 1 per cent systemic risk buffer on German residential real estate exposures above EUR 10 billion

summaries.en: A Dutch bank or an investment firm under the CRR whose exposures secured by residential real estate in Germany exceed EUR 10 billion, and which risk-weights them under the standardised approach with full cover by that real estate under Article 125(2) CRR or under the internal ratings based approach, holds a systemic risk buffer of 1 per cent for those exposures, calculated under Article 133(2) CRD, on an individual, sub-consolidated and consolidated basis as Part One, Title II, of the CRR applies.
